column1: # W52 UI-TARS-1.5-7B multi-step, rebuilt on the ADOPTED GUI-Owl serving protocol.
# WHY THIS SUPERSEDES w46_uitars_multi.tsv. Every row of the W46 matrix carried
# GEOPACT_SESSION_KV_FORCE=0, added there to hold serving constant across arms.
# That flag is applied at run_qwen_a100_five_arm_one.sh:2426, AFTER the abc_r10
# track exports GEOPACT_SESSION_KV=1, so it clobbers dialogue KV. Because
# nap_two_stage_active() requires dialogue_kv_enabled(), it also silently killed
# stage-1 current-frame pruning, i.e. it changed the SELECTOR, not just the
# serving path. Measured consequences in logs/w46_uitars_multi/omnigui:
#   keep_ratio == 1.0 on exactly 708 steps, one per episode (current frame unpruned)
#   GEOPACT_RATIO_CURRENT inert: c50_h10 and c25_h05 gave identical keep_ratio
#     histograms, 2545.6 vs 2395.6 tokens instead of a 2x separation
#   TRACE and nap_uniform were byte-identical, 29.70 vs 30.05 Step SR
#   TRACE kept 2546 tokens against pub_* 1636, so budgets were never matched
# The GUI-Owl arms that produce the adopted 48.91 / 43.08 OmniGUI anchors
# These rows copy that protocol verbatim and swap only the carrier, so the two
# backbones are finally evaluated under one serving discipline.
# PROTOCOL, fixed and not varied per arm:
#   UITARS_NATIVE_MULTISTEP=1  UI-TARS's own action space, with teacher-forced
#     history rendered in the same DSL. Without it the model emits <thought> and
#     never an action on 98% of steps.
#   UITARS_COORD_RESCALE=1     the stage-B gate measured every emitted point
#   session KV LEFT ALONE      abc_r10 exports GEOPACT_SESSION_KV=1 and
#     MODE=dialogue; the ui_tars wrapper requires the qwen2_5_vl carrier for it
# GRID. 6 selectors x 2 budgets x 2 datasets. History keep h = RATIO, current
# frame keep c = GEOPACT_RATIO_CURRENT for the nap/TRACE family and
# GEOPACT_PUBBASE_CURRENT for pub_* arms, matching how Tables 1-2 pair the stages.
# TRACE env blocks are copied per budget from w49_kv_exact.tsv rw1_* rows.
